title: Duties of the citizen
text: It shall be the duty of every citizen to ... abide by the Constitution, respect the dignity and rights of others, and contribute to the advancement of the community. (excerpt, 1999 Constitution as amended).

title: Right to life
text: Every person has a right to life, and no one shall be deprived intentionally of his life, save in execution of the sentence of a court in respect of a criminal offence ... (excerpt, 1999 Constitution as amended).

title: Right to dignity of the human person
text: Every individual is entitled to respect for the dignity of his person, and accordingly no person shall be subject to torture or to inhuman or degrading treatment ... (excerpt, 1999 Constitution as amended).

title: Right to personal liberty
text: Every person shall be entitled to his personal liberty and no person shall be deprived of such liberty save in the following cases ... (excerpt, 1999 Constitution as amended).

title: Right to fair hearing
text: In the determination of his civil rights and obligations ... a person shall be entitled to a fair hearing within a reasonable time by a court or other tribunal ... (excerpt, 1999 Constitution as amended).

title: Right to private and family life
text: The privacy of citizens, their homes, correspondence, telephone conversations and telegraphic communications is hereby guaranteed and protected. (1999 Constitution as amended).

title: Right to freedom of thought, conscience and religion
text: Every person shall be entitled to freedom of thought, conscience and religion, including freedom to change his religion or belief, and freedom ... to manifest and propagate his religion or belief in worship, teaching, practice and observance. (excerpt, 1999 Constitution as amended).

title: Right to freedom of expression and the press
text: Every person shall be entitled to freedom of expression, including freedom to hold opinions and to receive and impart ideas and information without interference. (excerpt, 1999 Constitution as amended).

title: Right to peaceful assembly and association
text: Every person shall be entitled to assemble freely and associate with other persons ... (excerpt, 1999 Constitution as amended).

title: Right to freedom of movement
text: Every citizen of Nigeria is entitled to move freely throughout Nigeria and to reside in any part thereof, and no citizen shall be expelled from Nigeria or refused entry thereby or exit therefrom. (excerpt, 1999 Constitution as amended).

title: Right to freedom from discrimination
text: A citizen of Nigeria of a particular community, ethnic group, place of origin, sex, religion or political opinion shall not ... be subjected to disabilities or restrictions to which citizens of other communities ... are not made subject ... (excerpt, 1999 Constitution as amended).

title: Right to acquire and own property
text: Subject to the provisions of this Constitution, every citizen of Nigeria shall have the right to acquire and own immovable property anywhere in Nigeria. (1999 Constitution as amended).

title: Protection against compulsory acquisition
text: No moveable property or any interest in an immovable property shall be taken possession of compulsorily ... except in the manner and for the purposes prescribed by a law that requires prompt payment of compensation ... (excerpt, 1999 Constitution as amended).

title: Permitted restrictions on rights
text: Nothing in sections 37, 38, 39, 40 and 41 shall invalidate any law reasonably justifiable in a democratic society in the interest of defence, public safety, public order, public morality or public health, or for protecting the rights of others. (excerpt, 1999 Constitution as amended).

title: Enforcement of fundamental rights
text: Any person who alleges that any of the provisions of this Chapter has been, is being or is likely to be contravened in any State in relation to him may apply to a High Court in that State for redress. (excerpt, 1999 Constitution as amended).
